_meta.name: Controlled Enums Registry
_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for all enum values used in spec JSON files. Agents MUST use values from this registry. No inventing new values without proposing an addition here first.
_meta.authority: This registry overrides any ad-hoc values found in individual spec files. When a conflict exists, this registry wins.

quality_tier.description: Quality tier classification. Drives prep intensity, inspection rigor, coat counts, and production rate modifiers.

definitions.QT2: Economy/Minimal - reduced prep, relaxed tolerances, fewer rounds
definitions.QT3: Standard - baseline for all rates and processes
definitions.QT4: Premium - thorough prep, systematic inspection, tighter tolerances
definitions.QT5: Superior - maximum effort, critical inspection, near-zero defect tolerance

quality_tier.notes: Not all specs use all tiers. Ceiling prime uses QT2-QT4 only. Door frame finish uses QT3-QT5 only. Spec must declare which tiers it supports in configuration_dimensions.

application_method.description: Primary paint application technique. Drives task selection, protection requirements, and production rates.

definitions.brush: Brush-only application (detail work, occupied spaces, trim/frames)
definitions.brush_roll: Brush and roller combination (closet shelves, small surfaces)
definitions.spray: Airless spray without backroll (economy ceiling, pre-install surfaces)
definitions.spray_backroll: Spray followed by immediate backroll with 18" roller (standard NC production)
definitions.spray_rolloff: Spray with light rolloff to work product into substrate grain (bare wood primer)

application_method.notes: Not all methods are valid for all specs. Wall prime excludes spray-only (RC-005: backroll always required on bare drywall). Spec must declare valid methods in configuration_dimensions.

sheen.description: Finish coating sheen level. NEVER use compound values like 'eggshell/satin' or 'semi-gloss+'. Always use a single canonical value.

definitions.flat: No sheen, maximum hide. Standard for ceilings.
definitions.matte: Near-flat with very slight sheen. Rarely specified.
definitions.eggshell: Low sheen. Common for walls QT3+.
definitions.satin: Medium sheen. Standard for trim/millwork QT3.
definitions.semi-gloss: High sheen. Standard for trim/frames QT4.

sheen.notes: If a spec needs to express 'satin or higher', use the minimum_quality_tier constraint in quality_sheen_rules, not a compound sheen value.

definitions.paint: Standard paint workflow (prime + finish) — existing specs
definitions.stain_clear: Stain application + sanding sealer + clear topcoat
definitions.clear_only: Clear coat over bare or stained wood, no stain applied

definitions.softwood: Pine, poplar, cedar, fir — requires wood conditioner before stain
definitions.hardwood: Oak, maple, cherry, walnut, birch — no conditioner needed

definitions.roll: Roll on and wipe excess (production method for trim)
definitions.spray: Spray on and wipe excess (less common — overspray and agitation concerns)
Spray application (most common for clear coat)

phase.description: SOP module phase classification. Controls sequencing order.

definitions.setup: Protection setup, floor covering, hardware masking, fixture removal
definitions.prep: Surface preparation - sanding, filling, caulking, dust removal, inspection/repair
definitions.apply: Generic coating application (used when phase is not specifically prime or finish)
definitions.interstage: Between-coat maintenance - inspect, sand, patch, clean dust
definitions.cleanup: Protection teardown, final inspection, tool cleaning, vacuum

phase.migration_note: Specs using 'protect' or 'protection' as a phase value should migrate to 'setup' for protection setup tasks. Protection teardown belongs in 'cleanup'.

task_classification.description: How a task's production rate relates to quality tier. ALWAYS use 'task_classification', NEVER 'task_class'.

definitions.binary: Same rate at all quality tiers. The task is done or not done. Application quality (no drips/sags/holidays) does not vary by tier.
definitions.qt_conditional: Task only appears in certain quality tiers. Rate may or may not vary within those tiers.
definitions.qt_scaled: Task exists at all applicable tiers but rate varies - slower at higher QT due to greater care/rigor.

task_type.description: Functional classification of what a task does. Informational grouping.

definitions.prep: Surface preparation (sanding, filling, caulking, dust removal)
definitions.apply: Generic coating application (when not specifically prime or finish)
definitions.protect: Protection setup or teardown (masking, floor covering)
definitions.detail: Detail/touch-up work (mortise touch-up, final inspection with touch-up)

skill_level.description: Minimum skill level required to perform a task.

definitions.helper: Entry level. Protection setup/teardown, dust removal, tool cleaning.
definitions.journeyman: Skilled painter. Application, prep, inspection, interstage work.
definitions.lead: Senior painter. Complex application, quality decisions, crew coordination.

unit_of_measure.description: Unit for counting paintable items and measuring task production rates. ALWAYS uppercase.

definitions.EA: Each - one discrete item (door frame set, opening, fixture)
definitions.LF: Linear Foot - edge work, trim runs, perimeter
definitions.SF: Square Foot - field area (wall, ceiling, floor protection)
definitions.EA_ROOM: Each Room - per-room heuristic (fixture counts, vacuum)
definitions.EA_OPENING: Each Opening - per opening tier (closet shelves S/M/L/XL)
definitions.EA_CLOSET: Each Closet - per closet unit (floor protection)
definitions.EA_SIDE: Each Side - per side of door slab
definitions.FIXED: Fixed allowance - flat time regardless of quantity (tool cleaning)

unit_of_measure.notes: Never use lowercase. 'each' must be 'EA'. 'ROOM' must be 'EA_ROOM'. 'FIXED_TIME' must be 'FIXED'.

uom_input.description: Unit of measure for PaintScope inputs. Superset of unit_of_measure with additional types.

definitions.ENUM: Enumerated value input (e.g., depth tier: SHALLOW/DEEP/VERY_DEEP)

consumable_unit.description: Unit for counting consumable items. ALWAYS uppercase.

definitions.EA: Each (brush, roller cover, sanding block, tack cloth, spray tip)
definitions.ROLL: Roll (masking tape, masking paper, rosin paper)

definitions.applicator: Brushes, rollers, spray tips - items that apply product
definitions.protection: Drop cloths, masking tape, masking paper, rosin paper, plastic sheeting
definitions.prep: Sandpaper, tack cloth, sanding blocks - surface preparation items
definitions.abrasive: Sandpaper, sanding sponges (may overlap with prep)
definitions.tool: Reusable tools tracked as consumables (putty knives, sanding blocks)

yield_uom.description: Unit of measure for consumable yield (how much work one unit covers).

definitions.SF: Square feet covered per consumable unit
definitions.LF: Linear feet covered per consumable unit
definitions.SF_FLOOR: Square feet of floor protected per consumable unit
definitions.LF_EDGE: Linear feet of edge masked per consumable unit
definitions.GAL: Gallons of product applied per consumable unit

product_role.description: Role of a product within a material system.

definitions.sealer: Edge sealer, knot sealer, substrate sealer
definitions.specialty: Specialty product not fitting other categories

substrate_state.description: Substrate condition state. Used in state_declarations for input/output tracking.

definitions.SS_BARE: Raw/uncoated substrate (bare wood, MDF, new drywall)
definitions.SS_PRIMED: Generic primed state (use more specific _FACTORY or _FIELD when known)
definitions.SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT: Interior sound existing paint (adhered, no visible defects, good condition)
definitions.SS_INT_FAILING_PAINT: Interior failing paint (localized cracking, crazing, or adhesion failure)
definitions.SS_INT_PEELING: Interior peeling paint (active delamination, coating lifting from substrate)
definitions.SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE: Interior moisture damage (water staining, mildew, mold, bubbling, or substrate swelling — source must be resolved before painting)
definitions.SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE: Interior smoke damage (nicotine, smoke, or soot staining — requires shellac-based stain blocker)
definitions.SS_STAINED: Stained wood — stain applied, no clear coat yet (NC stain specs output state)
definitions.SS_CLEAR_COATED: Clear-coated wood — stain and/or clear coat present (NC stain/clear specs output state)
definitions.SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY: Exterior factory-primed substrate (transit protection only — field prime mandatory)
definitions.SS_EXT_BARE_FIBERCEMENT: Bare fiber cement (pH 13.0, no factory primer — requires alkali-resistant primer)
definitions.SS_EXT_FACTORY_FINISHED: Factory-finished exterior substrate (ColorPlus/ExpertFinish — requires bonding primer)
definitions.SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD: Exterior bare wood (new construction or stripped)
definitions.SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT: Exterior sound existing paint (adhered, minimal chalk)
definitions.SS_EXT_STAINED_SOLID: Exterior solid stain (treat as painted — compatible with paint topcoat)
definitions.SS_EXT_STAINED_SEMI: Exterior semi-transparent stain (cannot paint over — re-stain only)
definitions.SS_EXT_FLASH_RUST: Exterior flash rust — surface oxidation only, no pitting (RP metal)
definitions.SS_EXT_MODERATE_RUST: Exterior moderate rust — visible pitting, scale beginning (RP metal, drives SP3 prep)
definitions.SS_EXT_HEAVY_RUST: Exterior heavy rust — deep pitting, thick scale deposits, not structural (RP metal, drives needle gun + SP3)
definitions.SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT_METAL: Exterior metal with sound existing paint coating — adhered, no rust breakthrough
definitions.SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT_METAL: Exterior metal with failing paint — cracking, peeling, rust bleed-through
definitions.SS_GRAIN_FILLED: Grain-filled surface — open grain pores filled, sealed with second prime coat, sanded 320 grit. Ready for finish paint. Output of SF_WOOD_GRAIN_FILL_NC.
definitions.SS_EXT_PAINTED_METAL: Exterior metal freshly painted — output state for metal RP specs

substrate_state.notes: Interior NC states use SS_ prefix. Interior RP states use SS_INT_ prefix. Exterior states use SS_EXT_ prefix. The three domains have distinct state taxonomies per Substrate_State_Reference.md §4.

protection_level.description: Intensity of protection required for a zone.

definitions.edge_only: Tape/drop cloth at edges only (perimeter drops, localized drip protection)
definitions.partial_cover: Tape plus paper or film covering part of surface
definitions.full_mask: Full tape line with draped plastic (finished walls during ceiling spray)

definitions.maintain: Verify and repair existing protection (from previous phase)

edge_type.description: Type of edge/junction between adjacent surfaces.

typical_relationship.description: Typical finish relationship between adjacent surfaces.

definitions.same_finish: Surfaces typically share same color/sheen (frame and casing)
definitions.different_finish: Surfaces typically have different color/sheen (wall and ceiling)
definitions.varies: Relationship varies by project (door slab and frame)

finish_group.description: Used in state protection rules to describe finish group relationship.

definitions.same: Adjacent surfaces are in the same finish group (same color)
definitions.different: Adjacent surfaces are in different finish groups (different colors)

definitions.smooth: Level 4-5 drywall finish, sanded trim, factory-primed surfaces

surface_profile.description: Surface profile complexity for grain fill production rate modifier. Drives hand work vs tool work on profiled surfaces.

definitions.flat: Cabinet doors, flat trim, flat panels (1.0x baseline)
definitions.light_profile: Simple casing, baseboard with small profile (1.3x)
definitions.medium_profile: Crown molding, chair rail, standard raised panel (2.0x)
definitions.heavy_profile: Ornate crown, complex raised panel, dentil trim (2.8x)

wood_grain_depth.description: Wood grain depth classification for grain fill production rate modifier.

definitions.deep_grain: Oak, hickory — deep pores, most common grain fill substrate (1.0x baseline)
definitions.moderate_grain: Ash, walnut — shallower pores, faster fill (0.85x)

definitions.level_3: Tape and compound only, no additional skim coat
definitions.level_5: Skim coat entire surface for uniform porosity

spec_status.description: Lifecycle status of a spec family.

definitions.approved: Reviewed and accepted for production use
definitions.active: Approved and in active production use
definitions.deprecated: Superseded by newer version, no longer active
definitions.referenced_not_built: Referenced by other specs but spec files not yet created

spec_status.notes: referenced_not_built is a parallel track for placeholder entries that other specs depend on but that have not yet been built.

version_pattern.description: Version numbering pattern for all spec files.

definitions.critical: Blocks spec from being used - broken cross-references, missing required fields
definitions.major: Significant issue but spec is usable - incorrect rates, missing coverage profiles
definitions.minor: Cosmetic or low-impact - naming inconsistency, missing notes

definitions.low: Limited data, significant assumptions, needs field validation
definitions.medium: Reasonable data, some assumptions, should be validated
definitions.high: Strong data, minimal assumptions, ready for use

modifier_mechanism.description: How a quality tier modifier affects production rates.

definitions.baseline: This tier defines the baseline rate (typically QT3 = 1.0)
definitions.baseline_reduction: Rate is reduced from baseline (QT2 = 0.80, less effort)
definitions.selective_multiplier: Rate is multiplied for specific task types (QT4/QT5 on qt_scaled tasks)
definitions.additional_rounds: Additional interstage rounds are added (QT4/QT5 second coat + interstage)
definitions.excluded: This tier is excluded from the spec entirely

frame_type.description: Door frame type variants. Specific to door frame specs.

definitions.standard: Standard swing door frame - full jambs + stop
definitions.pocket: Pocket door frame - no stop (door slides into wall)
definitions.cased_opening: Cased opening - jambs only, no stop, no hardware
definitions.bifold: Bifold door frame - track hardware instead of hinges

floor_type.description: Floor condition driving protection requirements. Site condition.

definitions.finished: Completed flooring installed - full protection required
definitions.partial: Flooring partially installed - protection required in finished areas
definitions.subfloor: Raw subfloor - protection may be excluded

condition_scale.description: Universal 3-level condition scale for substrate condition assessment. Applies to NC, interior RP, and exterior RP domains. Drives prep intensity modifiers.

definitions.GOOD: Sound condition — minimal prep required. NC: clean substrate ready for prime. RP: sound existing paint, degloss/scuff only. Prep modifier: 1.0x.
definitions.FAIR: Moderate condition — targeted repair required. NC: minor defects requiring fill/sand. RP: localized failure, moisture damage, or contamination requiring scrape/feather/spot prime. Prep modifier: 1.3-1.8x.
definitions.POOR: Severe condition — full remediation required. NC: significant substrate defects. RP: widespread coating failure, active peeling, or heavy contamination requiring full scrape/prime/skim. Prep modifier: 2.0-3.0x.

condition_scale.notes: Replaces exterior DSD 0-4 research parameter for estimation purposes. DSD 0-4 is retained as a research-only parameter, not used in PaintFactor estimation.
